description:
OEDRO Drop Running Boards are specifically designed for a perfect fit on the 2015-2025 Ford F150 and 2017-2024 F250 F350 Super Duty Supercrew Cab. Engineered with a rugged three-tube structure, these running boards offer superior protection for your vehicle's undercarriage and sides, preventing damage from obstacles such as rocks, curbs, or other road debris. With their sleek textured black finish and functional design, these running boards not only enhance the look of your truck but also provide easy and secure access, whether your truck is lifted or equipped with oversized tires.
Features
6-Inch Side Pedals for Enhanced Accessibility: The two-step design provides easier entry and exit, especially for lifted trucks or those with oversized tires. It’s perfect for improving convenience and safety, making access to your vehicle effortless for all passengers
Three-Tube Construction for Extra Protection: The unique three-tube design ensures maximum protection for both the bottom and sides of your vehicle. It helps prevent the running boards from getting caught on rocks, obstacles, or the suspension when driving off-road or navigating tight spaces.
Bolt-On Installation for Easy Setup: Enjoy a hassle-free, bolt-on installation with no need for cutting or drilling. Welded brackets provide added strength, ensuring your running boards are securely attached and can withstand heavy use.
Built to Endure the Elements: Featuring a durable, rust-resistant powder-coated finish, these running boards are designed to handle all weather conditions—rain, snow, mud, or dirt. They are built to last and maintain their sleek, black appearance for years.
Laser-Cut Tread for Superior Traction: The laser-cut, anti-slip tread provides superior grip, ensuring safe and secure footing when entering or exiting your vehicle. Whether you're navigating wet conditions or rugged terrain, these running boards offer reliable traction for every step.
1-year warranty. For your safety, professional installation is recommended
